remarks: Find a place where I can be ME! The perfect In-Town location with winter views of the Saugatuck River and convenience to Main Street with numerous restaurants, shopping, and festivals. Ride your bike to the Farmer's Market or Library. You'll be greeted by a warm and inviting porch when you drive up to the home. Once inside, you'll love the charm of yesteryear. The gourmet kitchen has a new refrigerator, beams, tile floor, and a half bath. The primary bedroom has a separate walk-in closet just outside the door, and two additional bedrooms with a renovated bath. The lower level has a new washer and dryer. It's freshly painted and ready for you to enjoy the best of summer ever! Please ask about pets. Sorry, NO SMOKING.
